decisions.reason: The existing same-message MODIFY already limits dashboard referral-reward and prize-ticket accounting to the new active contract and excludes old-contract NFT copies.
The existing same-message MODIFY already restarts mint statistics from the new active contract and excludes old-contract NFT copies.
The existing same-message MODIFY already restricts random no-code reward recipients to NFT holders in the new active contract.
The existing same-message MODIFY already makes new-contract mint numbers the active referral identities and excludes old-contract mint numbers.
The existing same-message MODIFY already limits project-system NFT visibility to the new active contract and excludes old-contract copies.
The existing same-message MODIFY already invalidates old-contract NFT mint numbers and accepts only NFTs minted by the new active contract.
The existing same-message MODIFY already restarts draw eligibility under the new active contract and excludes old-contract NFTs and tickets.
The existing same-message MODIFY already establishes new-contract ticket and draw scope without carrying old-contract NFTs into the active system.
The FAQ's universal referral-code and NFT-transfer wording would otherwise continue to imply that old-contract NFT mint numbers participate in project referral systems.

value_updates.referral_operation: Each NFT minted by the new active contract uses its mint number as its permanent referral code; old-contract NFT mint numbers and copies are excluded from project referral systems. Coded referrals earn $5 and current prize tickets, while a mint without a valid referral code sends the commission and tickets to a random existing NFT holder in the new active contract.
value_updates.nft_sale_transfer: For NFTs in the new active contract, the buyer receives the book, mint number as referral code, earned badges, and active prize tickets; expired tickets remain expired. Old-contract NFT copies are excluded from project systems.

decisions.reason: The active-contract migration does not change the $5 commission or one Small Block ticket awarded for a successful coded referral.
The certificate and confirmation-email contents for new mints remain valid; the source decision does not change their delivery, reading actions, or required fields.
The existing validation messages remain valid within the active referral system and do not assert that old-contract NFT holders are eligible.
